name: manual_26cc05
claim: Cross-machine knowledge transfer pathway: Win AutoResearcher (start.ps1 / Hermes) generates episodic evidence via skills like skill-absorption-map → auto_dream.py clusters them into candidates in PT .agent/memory → candidates persist across dream cycles until a human reviews on Mac. This is how Hermes self-assessments, Win session diagnostics, and AutoResearcher findings arrive in the shared portable brain. The pathway is: Win skill/session → AGENT_LEARNINGS.jsonl (evidence_ids) → auto_dream staging → REVIEW_QUEUE.md → human graduate/reject on Mac.
conditions: cross-machine learning transfer hermes windows autodresearcher pathway episodic

decisions.notes: Meta-lesson surfaced 2026-07-04 while graduating bb70a6833f36 (Hermes skill-absorption-map self-assessment staged 2026-06-22, re-staged 47x over 12 days). The pathway explains why Win-originated candidates can sit staged for days: auto_dream runs on both machines but only a human session on either machine can graduate them.
